about: The price files code reads, by path from the repo root. Checked by backend/datafeed/store/manifest.py. The real files are IBKR data, licensed for the owner's own use only: untracked, never committed (public repo). Only the synthetic fixture is in git.

source.licence: IBKR market data, the owner's own use only: no redistribution, never in the public repo
source.contract: XAUUSD CMDTY (London gold spot, IBKR secType CMDTY; the repo's IBKR code asks for Contract(symbol='XAUUSD', secType='CMDTY', exchange='SMART', currency='USD'))
source.what_to_show_note: unknown: the code that downloaded and converted this file isn't in the repo or any notes. The repo's IBKR history requests use MIDPOINT (backend/datafeed/ingest/ibkr.py, tools/data/fetch_data_xauusd.py), but this file's VOL column is positive on every row but one, and IBKR MIDPOINT bars carry no volume (-1; the old live bars had 0). So this file is probably not plain MIDPOINT. The backfill proposal settles it on the overlap (docs/BACKFILL_2026_PROPOSAL.md).
source.how: downloaded from IBKR and converted to this text format by the owner, one-off (database/README.md); the download script and date are not recorded

database/ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.format: CSV with CRLF line ends. Line 1 is a header with a stray prefix: 'should contai<TICKER>,<DTYYYYMMDD>,<TIME>,<OPEN>,<HIGH>,<LOW>,<CLOSE>,<VOL>'. Then one 1-min bar per line: TICKER (XAUUSD),YYYYMMDD,HHMMSS,OPEN,HIGH,LOW,CLOSE,VOL; the time is the bar's open (the last bar before the daily break is 21:59 UTC in winter, the break being 22:00-23:00 UTC).
database/ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.timezone: UTC throughout the file (research/vol_features/DATA_AUDIT_LONG.md: best shift 0 in every year where it can be identified; research/levels_confirm/DATA_AUDIT_2024.md: UTC 2024-01 .. 2026-01; 2020-2023 equal the clean parquet close for close)
database/ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.timezone_break: 2026-02-01: IBKR XAUUSD data fetched later switches from UTC to US-Eastern timestamps on that date. Seen in database/snapshots/XAUUSD_COMPLETE.csv (tools/data/fetch_data_xauusd.py, formatDate=1, which returns times in the TWS login's time zone): research/vol_features/DECISIONS.md item 6, research/levels_confirm/DATA_AUDIT_2024.md. This file ends 2026-01-30 21:59 UTC, before the break, and is UTC throughout. Any later IBKR data must be requested in UTC (formatDate=2) and checked against the session pattern, never assumed UTC.
database/ohlcv_data/XAUUSD.txt.known_issues: not sorted as stored; 1 duplicate timestamp and 1 bad OHLC row, both before 2020; usable years 2007-2023 by the audit's U1-U3 rules (DATA_AUDIT_LONG.md)

source.how: a one-off export (its script was never in git); reproduced exactly by tools/data/build_clean_parquet.py

cleaning_steps: read date + time as UTC (no shift)
keep rows with timestamp >= 2020-01-01 00:00 UTC (the first kept row is 2020-01-01 23:00)
sort by timestamp; the kept range has no duplicate timestamps and no bad OHLC bars, so nothing is dropped
columns timestamp (datetime64[ns, UTC]), open, high, low, close, volume (float64; VOL as is)
database/ohlcv_data/XAUUSD_1min_UTC_clea.verified: 2026-10-22: all 2,156,239 rows equal the XAUUSD.txt rows with the same timestamp in open, high, low, close and volume, and no XAUUSD.txt row in the range is missing; tools/data/build_clean_parquet.py reproduces content_sha256
